This step may be necessary for serious issues or when direct resolution isn't feasible. 4. **Contextual Considerations**: - Evaluate the cultural norms, effectiveness of local authorities, and legal requirements in handling disputes. Understand whether reporting leads to timely resolutions or becomes bureaucratic. 5. **Nature of the Dispute**: - Assess the severity of the issue.
